controls.TB01_PSRR:
.control
set noaskquit
set numdgt=15
set wr_vecnames
set wr_singlescale
unset appendwrite
shell mkdir -p /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests
echo TB01_PSRR_V1 > /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB01_PSRR_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo DUT_Bandgap_Core_UNMODIFIED_TT_25C >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB01_PSRR_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo MIM_CHARGE_COMPAT_CAP_MIM_2F0FF_NOMINAL_NO_EXTRA_LOAD >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB01_PSRR_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo 5 V, 25 C - AC: 1 Hz to 100 MHz. Target: 60 dB minimum over 1 Hz to 1 MHz. >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB01_PSRR_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
set appendwrite
save v(avdd) v(vref) i(vdd)
op
let OP_VREF_V=v(vref)
let OP_IDD_UA=-i(vdd)*1e6
let OP_VALID=0
if abs(OP_VREF_V-1.194) <= 0.005*1.194
 let OP_VALID=1
end
set tb_op_valid=$&OP_VALID
print OP_VREF_V OP_IDD_UA OP_VALID >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB01_PSRR_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
ac dec 100 1 100Meg
let H=v(vref)/v(avdd)
let PSRR_DB=-db(H)
let H_REAL=real(H)
let H_IMAG=imag(H)
meas ac PSRR_1HZ_DB find PSRR_DB at=1
meas ac PSRR_1KHZ_DB find PSRR_DB at=1k
meas ac PSRR_1MHZ_DB find PSRR_DB at=1Meg
meas ac PSRR_MIN_1HZ_1MHZ_DB min PSRR_DB from=1 to=1Meg
let PSRR_PASS=0
if $tb_op_valid
 if PSRR_MIN_1HZ_1MHZ_DB >= 60
  let PSRR_PASS=1
 end
end
print PSRR_1HZ_DB PSRR_1KHZ_DB PSRR_1MHZ_DB PSRR_MIN_1HZ_1MHZ_DB PSRR_PASS >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB01_PSRR_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo BEGIN_AC_DATA_FREQUENCY_HZ_PSRR_DB_H_REAL_H_IMAG >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB01_PSRR_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
wrdata /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB01_PSRR_UPLOAD_THIS.txt PSRR_DB H_REAL H_IMAG
echo END_AC_DATA >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB01_PSRR_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo END_OF_TB01_PSRR_RUN >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB01_PSRR_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo UPLOAD_THIS_FILE /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB01_PSRR_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
.endc
controls.TB02_LINE_REGULATION:
.control
set noaskquit
set numdgt=15
set wr_vecnames
set wr_singlescale
unset appendwrite
shell mkdir -p /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests
echo TB02_LINE_REGULATION_V1 > /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB02_LINE_REGULATION_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo DUT_Bandgap_Core_UNMODIFIED_TT_25C >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB02_LINE_REGULATION_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo MIM_CHARGE_COMPAT_CAP_MIM_2F0FF_NOMINAL_NO_EXTRA_LOAD >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB02_LINE_REGULATION_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo 25 C - VDD sweep: 3.3 V to 5 V in 10 mV steps. >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB02_LINE_REGULATION_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
set appendwrite
save v(avdd) v(vref) i(vdd)
dc vdd 3.3 5 0.01
let VREF_V=v(vref)
let IDD_UA=-i(vdd)*1e6
let VDD_V=v(avdd)
let VREF_SPAN_MV=(vecmax(VREF_V)-vecmin(VREF_V))*1e3
let LINE_SPAN_PERCENT=VREF_SPAN_MV/1000/1.194*100
let LINE_SPAN_MV_PER_V=VREF_SPAN_MV/1.7
let LOCAL_SLOPE_MV_PER_V=deriv(VREF_V)*1e3
let MAX_ABS_LOCAL_SLOPE_MV_PER_V=vecmax(abs(LOCAL_SLOPE_MV_PER_V))
let VREF_AT_3P3V=VREF_V[0]
let LAST_POINT=length(VREF_V)-1
let VREF_AT_5V=VREF_V[LAST_POINT]
let ENDPOINT_SLOPE_MV_PER_V=(VREF_AT_5V-VREF_AT_3P3V)*1e3/1.7
let MAX_ABS_VREF_ERROR_V=vecmax(abs(VREF_V-1.194))
let ALL_POINTS_VALID=0
if MAX_ABS_VREF_ERROR_V <= 0.005*1.194
 let ALL_POINTS_VALID=1
end
print VREF_AT_3P3V VREF_AT_5V VREF_SPAN_MV LINE_SPAN_PERCENT LINE_SPAN_MV_PER_V ENDPOINT_SLOPE_MV_PER_V MAX_ABS_LOCAL_SLOPE_MV_PER_V ALL_POINTS_VALID >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB02_LINE_REGULATION_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo BEGIN_DC_DATA_VDD_V_VREF_V_IDD_UA_LOCAL_SLOPE_MV_PER_V >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB02_LINE_REGULATION_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
wrdata /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB02_LINE_REGULATION_UPLOAD_THIS.txt VREF_V IDD_UA LOCAL_SLOPE_MV_PER_V
echo END_DC_DATA >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB02_LINE_REGULATION_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo END_OF_TB02_LINE_REGULATION_RUN >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB02_LINE_REGULATION_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo UPLOAD_THIS_FILE /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB02_LINE_REGULATION_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
.endc
controls.TB03_STARTUP_RESTART:
.control
set noaskquit
set numdgt=15
set wr_vecnames
set wr_singlescale
unset appendwrite
shell mkdir -p /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests
echo TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_V1 > /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo DUT_Bandgap_Core_UNMODIFIED_TT_25C >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo MIM_CHARGE_COMPAT_CAP_MIM_2F0FF_NOMINAL_NO_EXTRA_LOAD >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
echo 5 V, 25 C - 100 us first ramp, 500 us power-off, 1 us restart ramp. >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
set appendwrite
save v(avdd) v(vref) i(vdd)
* No UIC, forced initial state, startup kick or nodeset.
tran 1u 6m 0 50n
let SIM_END_S=vecmax(time)
print SIM_END_S >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
if SIM_END_S < 0.005999
 echo TRANSIENT_ABORTED_NO_VALID_COMPLETION >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
 echo UPLOAD_THIS_FILE /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
else
 meas tran PRE_VREF_V avg v(vref) from=3800u to=4000u
 meas tran FINAL_VREF_V avg v(vref) from=5800u to=6m
 meas tran FINAL_SUPPLY_CURRENT_A avg i(vdd) from=5800u to=6m
 let FINAL_IDD_UA=-FINAL_SUPPLY_CURRENT_A*1e6
 let REL_ERROR=abs(v(vref)-PRE_VREF_V)/(abs(PRE_VREF_V)+1e-12)
 meas tran START_MAX_REL_ERROR max REL_ERROR from=401u to=4m
 meas tran RESTART_MAX_REL_ERROR max REL_ERROR from=4801u to=6m
 meas tran START_PEAK_V max v(vref) from=0 to=4m
 meas tran RESTART_PEAK_V max v(vref) from=4500u to=6m
 meas tran FINAL_MAX_V max v(vref) from=5800u to=6m
 meas tran FINAL_MIN_V min v(vref) from=5800u to=6m
 let FINAL_PP_V=FINAL_MAX_V-FINAL_MIN_V
 let PRE_VALID=0
 let FINAL_VALID=0
 if abs(PRE_VREF_V-1.194) <= 0.005*1.194
  let PRE_VALID=1
 end
 if abs(FINAL_VREF_V-1.194) <= 0.005*1.194
  let FINAL_VALID=1
 end
 let START_READY_300US=0
 let RESTART_READY_300US=0
 if PRE_VALID
  if START_MAX_REL_ERROR <= 0.005
   let START_READY_300US=1
  end
  if FINAL_VALID
   if RESTART_MAX_REL_ERROR <= 0.005
    let RESTART_READY_300US=1
   end
  end
 end
 print PRE_VREF_V FINAL_VREF_V FINAL_IDD_UA START_MAX_REL_ERROR RESTART_MAX_REL_ERROR START_PEAK_V RESTART_PEAK_V FINAL_PP_V PRE_VALID FINAL_VALID START_READY_300US RESTART_READY_300US >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
 * Metrics use adaptive timepoints; exported waveform uses a 1 us grid.
 linearize v(avdd) v(vref) i(vdd)
 let IDD_UA=-i(vdd)*1e6
 echo BEGIN_TRAN_DATA_TIME_S_VDD_V_VREF_V_IDD_UA >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
 wrdata /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_UPLOAD_THIS.txt v(avdd) v(vref) IDD_UA
 echo END_TRAN_DATA >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
 echo END_OF_TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_RUN >> /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
 echo UPLOAD_THIS_FILE /foss/designs/chipalooza-bandgap/individual_tests/TB03_STARTUP_RESTART_UPLOAD_THIS.txt
end
.endc
